name: fog-rise
title: Fog Rise
description: Display text resolves out of fog center-out, sharpening from heavy blur as it tilts up on a spring.
useWhen: A big display word should materialize out of atmosphere, resolving from heavy blur as if rising along the z-axis.
The center characters resolve first and the edges follow.
avoidWhen: The whole line should sharpen at once without per-character order: use focus-blur-resolve.
Characters should travel up from below the baseline: use per-character-rise or bottom-up-letters.
author: Studio

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames between each ring of characters, center first (30 fps).

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Starting blur as a fraction of the font size.

variables.label: Tilt
variables.description: Degrees the line is tipped back before it rises.

variables.label: Lift
variables.description: How far below its place the line starts, in font sizes.

variables.label: Drift
variables.description: Slow upward creep per frame, in font sizes.

variables.label: Exit at
variables.description: Frame where the line starts to accelerate upward and out (30 fps).

variables.label: Exit acceleration
variables.description: How hard the line accelerates out.

variables.label: Spread gap
variables.description: Extra gap between letters at the start, in font sizes. It closes as the spring settles.

variables.label: Resolve frames
variables.description: Frames the blur takes to clear after the last ring starts.

variables.label: Fade frames
variables.description: Frames each character takes to fade in.
